Grand Theft Auto V is an action-adventure video game developed by Rockstar North and published by Rockstar Games. It was released in September 2013 for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, in November 2014 for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, and in April 2015 for Microsoft Windows. It is the first main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series since 2008's Grand Theft Auto IV. Set within the fictional state of San Andreas, based on Southern California, the single-player story follows three criminals and their efforts to commit heists while under pressure from a government agency. The open world design lets players freely roam San Andreas' open countryside and the fictional city of Los Santos, based on Los Angeles.

The game is played from either a third-person or first-person perspective and its world is navigated on foot or by vehicle. Players control the three lead protagonists throughout single-player and switch between them both during and outside missions. The story is centred on the heist sequences, and many missions involve shooting and driving gameplay. A "wanted" system governs the aggression of law enforcement response to players who commit crimes. Grand Theft Auto Online, the game's online multiplayer mode, lets up to 30 players engage in a variety of different cooperative and competitive game modes.

Development of Grand Theft Auto V began soon after Grand Theft Auto IV's release and was shared between many of Rockstar's studios worldwide. The development team drew influence from many of their previous projects such as Red Dead Redemption and Max Payne 3, and designed the game around three lead protagonists to innovate on the core structure of its predecessors. Much of the development work constituted the open world's creation, and several team members conducted field research around California to capture footage for the design team. The game's soundtrack features an original score composed by a team of producers who collaborated over several years.

Gerald "Slink" Johnson and Shawn Darnell Fonteno are back on Experts React!
And this time we will go way back to the legendary GTA: San Andreas!
Lamar and Franklin were young homies when the "San Andreas" saga takes off... in a time when pixels were the size of a box, this game would become the game of a generation and pave the way for the famous GTA:V.
Slink and Shawn will go to the roots and give us insight into the "hood", drugs, guns and the Po-po... as we follow CJ, Sweet, Big Smoke and Ryder get caught up in the war between Grove and Ballas while the map turns red.
And watch Tenpenny make life hell for CJ.
How was it like in the "hood"?

Take a trip down memory lane and rediscover the truth of GTA: San Andreas!

Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas is a 2004 action-adventure game developed by Rockstar North and published by Rockstar Games. It is the seventh title in the Grand Theft Auto series, and the follow-up to the 2002 game Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. It was released in October 2004 for PlayStation 2, and in June 2005 for Microsoft Windows and Xbox. The game is set within an open world environment that players can explore and interact with at their leisure. The story follows former gangster Carl "CJ" Johnson, who returns home after the death of his mother and is drawn back into his former gang and a life of crime while clashing with corrupt authorities, rival criminal syndicates, and other enemies. Carl's journey takes him across the fictional U.S. state of San Andreas, which is heavily based on California and Nevada.

Something you might not know is Shawn Fonteno, who voiced Franklin, is actually the cousin of Young Maylay, who is actually the voice actor of Carl Johnson. Although they are not relatives in the games, their voice actors really are.

snippet.title: Franklin and Lamar's Voice Actors React to The Contract DLC
snippet.description:
Get ready for an unforgettable episode of Experts React, as Gerald "Slink" Johnson and Shawn Darnell Fonteno, the iconic voices behind Lamar Davis and Franklin Clinton, dive into the world of Grand Theft Auto Online's latest update, The Contract. This time, they'll be reacting to the incredible DLC featuring none other than the legendary Dr. Dre himself. Prepare to be captivated by Slink and Shawn's unique brand of hood wisdom, as they share their thoughts on the game's portrayal of life in the streets and their deep admiration for the iconic rapper turned entrepreneur. With their infectious energy and unfiltered commentary, this dynamic duo will take you on a wild ride filled with laughter, insights, and plenty of colorful language. So, sit back, light one up, and join Slink and Shawn as they explore the gritty, glamorous world of The Contract.

The Contract is a game-changing content update for Grand Theft Auto Online, the multiplayer component of Rockstar Games' critically acclaimed Grand Theft Auto V. Released on December 15, 2021, this DLC introduces an exciting new storyline that revolves around the music industry mogul, Dr. Dre. Players are tasked with helping the legendary artist recover his lost phone, which contains unreleased music that could change the face of the industry. As they navigate the dangerous streets of Los Santos and rub shoulders with the city's elite, players will encounter a cast of colorful characters and face off against ruthless rivals in their quest to secure Dr. Dre's valuable property. With new missions, vehicles, weapons, and exclusive music from the man himself, The Contract offers a fresh and immersive experience that expands upon the already massive world of Grand Theft Auto Online. Whether you're a die-hard fan of the series or a newcomer looking for an adrenaline-fueled adventure, this DLC is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat.
